## Introduction

This document describes the data analysis pipeline to extract potential CYP2E1-dependent metabolites from the pre-processed feature tables and corresponding MGF files. It uses a combination of filtering, exact mass matching and post-acquisition neutral loss analysis. Characteristic neutral losses for conjugates are described in [@levsen2005] and [@brink2014]. The `metamorphr` package is primarily used for data analysis [@schermer].

## Setup

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(metamorphr)
library(ggsankey)
```

## Preparational steps

### Define Characteristic Neutral Losses

Characteristic neutral losses are described in [@levsen2005] and [@brink2014]. This analysis primarily focuses on several conjugates (i.e., glutathione, sulfate and glucuronic acid).

```{r define-nl}
glutathione_pos <- c(75.0320,
                     129.0426,
                     232.0696,
                     146.0692,
                     249.0961,
                     273.0961,
                     275.1117,
                     305.0682,
                     307.0838)

glutathione_neg <- c(306.0765,
                     273.0961)


sulfate_pos <- c(63.9619,
                 79.9568)

sulfate_neg <- c(63.9619,
                 79.9568)


gluc_acid_pos <- c(176.0321,
                   194.0427)

gluc_acid_neg <- c(176.0321)
```


### Read Data

Feature tables and corresponding MGF files are read and analyzed using the `metamorphr` package.

#### Read the Feature Tables

```{r read-ft}
csv_files <- list.files("input/csv/")
cpd_names <- str_remove_all(csv_files, "^rp18\\_|\\.csv$|4\\-")

csv_file_paths <- paste0("input/csv/", csv_files) 
names(csv_file_paths) <- cpd_names

csv_feature_tables <- csv_file_paths %>%
  map(read_featuretable, label_col = 1, metadata_cols = 2:3) %>%
  map(mutate, FEATURE_ID = UID)

```

#### Create a Metadata Table

A metadata table is created for the feature tables and then joined to them.

```{r create-metadata-table}
metadata_table <- csv_feature_tables %>%
  map(create_metadata_skeleton) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  distinct()

metadata_table <- metadata_table %>%
  mutate(Group = case_when(str_detect(Sample, "^QC_") ~ "QC",
                           str_detect(Sample, "^B[0-9]{1,}") ~ str_remove_all(
                             Sample, "^B[0-9]{1,}\\_|\\_[0-9]{1,}\\_[0-9]{1,}\\_[0-9]{1,}\\_[0-9]{1,}$"
                            ))) %>%
  mutate(Replicate = case_when(Group != "QC" ~ str_remove_all(
    Sample, "^B[0-9]{1,}\\_[0-9A-Za-z]{1,}\\_.[0-9A-Za-z]{1,}\\_|\\_[0-9]{1,}\\_[0-9]{1,}\\_[0-9]{1,}$|^B[0-9]{1,}\\_[0-9A-Za-z]{1,}\\_"
  ),
  .default = "1")) %>%
  mutate(Batch = case_when(Sample != "QC" ~ str_extract(Sample, "^B[0-9]{1,}"),
                           .default = NA))
```

Join them together.

```{r join-metadata}
csv_feature_tables <- csv_feature_tables %>%
  map(join_metadata, metadata_table)
```

#### Read MGF Files

MGF files are read and then joined to the feature tables.

```{r read-mgf}
mgf_files <- list.files("input/mgf/")
cpd_names_mgf <- str_remove_all(mgf_files, "^rp18\\_|\\.mgf$|4\\-")

mgf_file_paths <- paste0("input/mgf/", mgf_files) 
names(mgf_file_paths) <- cpd_names_mgf

mgf_spectra <- mgf_file_paths %>%
  map(read_mgf)
```

Verify correct order before joining operation.

```{r compare-order}
waldo::compare(names(mgf_spectra), names(csv_feature_tables))
```

Join them together.

```{r join-mgf}
csv_feature_tables <- map2(csv_feature_tables, mgf_spectra, left_join, by = "FEATURE_ID")
```

## Data Analysis

### Data cleaning

Some initial steps are performed prior to metabolite and conjugate screening:

1.  Remove QC samples as they are not needed for downstream analysis

2.  "Subtract" blank samples by filtering out features were the maximum intensity in samples is less than 3x as high as the maximum intensity in blank samples

3.  Remove blank samples as they are not needed for downstream analysis

4.  Remove "noise" (i.e., features that were not detected in at least 3 out of 4 samples of at least one group

The number of features after each step are saved to create a summary plot.

```{r data-clean-def-old}
clean_pipe <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    filter(Group != "QC") %>%
    filter_blank(blank_samples = "PBS", min_frac = 3, blank_as_group = T, group_column = Group) %>%
    filter(Group != "PBS") %>%
    filter_grouped_mv(min_found = 0.75, fraction = T, group_column = Group)
}
```

```{r data-clean-def}
clean_pipe <- function(data) {
  n_features <- tibble(
    Step = c("all features", 
             "after blank subtraction", 
             "after removing irreproducible features"),
    n = c(length(unique(data$UID)),
          NA,
          NA)
  )
  
  data <- data %>%
    filter(Group != "QC") %>%
    filter_blank(blank_samples = "PBS", min_frac = 3, blank_as_group = T, group_column = Group)
  
  n_features[2, 2] <- length(unique(data$UID))
  
  data <- data %>%
    filter(Group != "PBS") %>%
    filter_grouped_mv(min_found = 0.75, fraction = T, group_column = Group)
  
  n_features[3, 2] <- length(unique(data$UID))
  
  list(
    data = data,
    n_features = n_features
  )
}
```

```{r data-clean}
csv_feature_tables_cleaned <- csv_feature_tables %>%
  map(clean_pipe)
```

The feature tables and the tables containing the numbers of features are extracted.

```{r extract-tables-numbers}
extract_numbers <- function(data) {
  data[["n_features"]]
}

extract_ft <- function(data) {
  data[["data"]]
}

n_features <- map(csv_feature_tables_cleaned, extract_numbers)

csv_feature_tables_cleaned <- map(csv_feature_tables_cleaned, extract_ft)
```

### Screen for Potential Conjugates

#### Calculate Neutral Losses 

First, neutral losses are calculated for each feature.

```{r calc-nl}
csv_feature_tables_cleaned <- csv_feature_tables_cleaned %>%
  map(calc_neutral_loss, m_z_col = `m/z`)
```

#### Split Feature Table List

The feature tables list is split into positive and negative.

```{r split-pos-neg}
csv_feature_tables_cleaned_pos <- csv_feature_tables_cleaned[str_detect(names(csv_feature_tables_cleaned), "^pos")]
csv_feature_tables_cleaned_neg <- csv_feature_tables_cleaned[str_detect(names(csv_feature_tables_cleaned), "^neg")]
```

#### Screen

The screening is done for all conjugates, positive and negative ionization mode. At least 40 % of the characteristic neutral losses, rounded up to the next integer must be found for a feature to be considered a possible conjugate. A tolerance of 10 ppm is used, 5 ppm for the precursor mass and 5 ppm for the fragment mass. 

The number of features after this step are counted again:

```{r}
count_features <- function(data, curr_step) {
  tibble(
    Step = curr_step,
    n = length(unique(data$UID))
  )
}
```


##### Glutathione

```{r screen-gsh}
pot_conj_gsh_pos <- csv_feature_tables_cleaned_pos %>%
  map(filter_neutral_loss, 
      losses = glutathione_pos, 
      min_found = ceiling(length(glutathione_pos) * 0.4), 
      tolerance = 10,
      tolerance_type = "ppm")

pot_conj_gsh_neg <- csv_feature_tables_cleaned_neg %>%
  map(filter_neutral_loss, 
      losses = glutathione_neg, 
      min_found = ceiling(length(glutathione_neg) * 0.4), 
      tolerance = 10,
      tolerance_type = "ppm")

n_ft_pot_conj_gsh <- c(pot_conj_gsh_neg,
                       pot_conj_gsh_pos) %>%
  map(count_features, "after neutral loss screening")
```

##### Sulfate

```{r screen-sulfate}
pot_conj_sulfate_pos <- csv_feature_tables_cleaned_pos %>%
  map(filter_neutral_loss, 
      losses = sulfate_pos, 
      min_found = ceiling(length(sulfate_pos) * 0.4), 
      tolerance = 10,
      tolerance_type = "ppm")

pot_conj_sulfate_neg <- csv_feature_tables_cleaned_neg %>%
  map(filter_neutral_loss, 
      losses = sulfate_neg, 
      min_found = ceiling(length(sulfate_neg) * 0.4), 
      tolerance = 10,
      tolerance_type = "ppm")

n_ft_pot_conj_sulfate <- c(pot_conj_sulfate_neg,
                           pot_conj_sulfate_pos) %>%
  map(count_features, "after neutral loss screening")
```

##### Glucuronic acid

```{r screen-glucacid}
pot_conj_glucacid_pos <- csv_feature_tables_cleaned_pos %>%
  map(filter_neutral_loss, 
      losses = gluc_acid_pos, 
      min_found = ceiling(length(gluc_acid_pos) * 0.4), 
      tolerance = 10,
      tolerance_type = "ppm")

pot_conj_glucacid_neg <- csv_feature_tables_cleaned_neg %>%
  map(filter_neutral_loss, 
      losses = gluc_acid_neg, 
      min_found = ceiling(length(gluc_acid_neg) * 0.4), 
      tolerance = 10,
      tolerance_type = "ppm")

n_ft_pot_conj_glucacid <- c(pot_conj_glucacid_neg,
                            pot_conj_glucacid_pos) %>%
  map(count_features, "after neutral loss screening")
```

##### Calculate Number of Retained Features

```{r retained-after-screen-list}
n_ft_after_screen <- list(
  n_ft_pot_conj_glucacid,
  n_ft_pot_conj_gsh,
  n_ft_pot_conj_sulfate
) %>%
  transpose() %>%
  map(bind_rows) %>%
  map(group_by, Step) %>%
  map(summarise, n = sum(n))

```

#### Remove Features that are also Found in Controls

First, a new group column is created. All controls are allocated to the same group and Hep-G2-2E1 cells treated with compound are allocated to another group.

```{r def-alloc-groups}
allocate_groups <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    mutate(Group2 = case_when(str_detect(Group, "^[A-Za-z]{1,}_2e1") ~ "cpd",
                              .default = "ctrl")) %>%
    mutate(Group2 = case_when(str_detect(Group, "^med_2e1") ~ "ctrl",
                              .default = Group2))
}
```

##### Glutathione

```{r filter-gsh}
filtered_pot_conj_gsh_neg <- pot_conj_gsh_neg %>%
  map(allocate_groups) %>%
  map(filter_blank, 
      blank_samples = "ctrl", 
      min_frac = 3, 
      blank_as_group = TRUE, 
      group_column = Group2)

filtered_pot_conj_gsh_pos <- pot_conj_gsh_pos %>%
  map(allocate_groups) %>%
  map(filter_blank, 
      blank_samples = "ctrl", 
      min_frac = 3, 
      blank_as_group = TRUE, 
      group_column = Group2)

n_ft_filtered_pot_conj_gsh <- c(filtered_pot_conj_gsh_neg,
                                filtered_pot_conj_gsh_pos) %>%
  map(count_features, "after removing features found in HepG2-wt")
```


##### Calculate Number of Retained Features

###### Total

```{r retained-after-screen}
n_ft_after_filter <- list(
  n_ft_filtered_pot_conj_glucacid,
  n_ft_filtered_pot_conj_gsh,
  n_ft_filtered_pot_conj_sulfate
) %>%
  transpose() %>%
  map(bind_rows) %>%
  map(group_by, Step) %>%
  map(summarise, n = sum(n))

```

###### By Conjugate

```{r retained-after-screen-by-conj}

n_ft_after_filter_mut <- list(
  map(n_ft_filtered_pot_conj_glucacid, mutate, Step = "Glucuronic acid"),
  map(n_ft_filtered_pot_conj_gsh, mutate, Step = "Glutathione"),
  map(n_ft_filtered_pot_conj_sulfate, mutate, Step = "Sulfate")
) %>%
  transpose() %>%
  map(bind_rows) %>%
  map(group_by, Step) %>%
  map(summarise, n = sum(n))

```

#### Visualize Number of Features

```{r vis-sankey}
n_features_viz <- n_features %>%
  map2(n_ft_after_screen, rbind) %>%
  map2(n_ft_after_filter, rbind)


make_sankey <- function(data) {
  n_rows <- data$n[1]
  n_cols <- nrow(data)
   
  return_df <- matrix(nrow = n_rows,
                      ncol = n_cols)
   
  for (i in 1:n_cols) {
    return_df[1:(n_rows - (n_rows - data$n[i])), i] <- c(rep(data$Step[i], n_rows - (n_rows - data$n[i])))
     
    if (i == n_cols) {
      break
    }
     
    return_df[1:(n_rows - (n_rows - data$n[i])), (i + 1)] <- paste0("zzzremoved", (n_cols + 1) - i)
  }
  as_tibble(return_df)
}


combine_counts_conj <- function(count_df, conjugate_df) {
  ncols_cdf <- ncol(count_df)
  nrows_cdf <- nrow(count_df)
  
  new_col_name <- paste0("V", ncols_cdf + 1)
  
  return_tbl <- tibble(
    new_col = c(rep(conjugate_df$Step, conjugate_df$n),
                rep(NA, nrows_cdf - sum(conjugate_df$n)))
  )
  
  colnames(return_tbl) <- new_col_name
  
  cbind(count_df, return_tbl)
}


sample_sankey_pos_nphl <- n_features_viz[["pos_nitrophenol"]] %>%
  make_sankey() %>% 
  combine_counts_conj(n_ft_after_filter_mut[["pos_nitrophenol"]]) %>% 
  make_long(V1, V2, V3, V4, V5, V6) %>%
  filter(!is.na(node)) %>%
  filter(!(is.na(x) & is.na(next_x) & is.na(next_node))) %>%
  mutate(keep_ft = case_when(stringr::str_detect(node, "zzzremoved") ~ "removed",
                          .default = "zkept")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = x, 
             next_x = next_x, 
             node = node, 
             next_node = next_node,
             fill = keep_ft)) +
    geom_sankey(flow.alpha = .6,
                width = 0.2) +
    theme_void() +
    labs(title = "4-nitrophenol, positive") +
    theme(legend.position = "none")


sample_sankey_neg_nphl <- n_features_viz[["neg_nitrophenol"]] %>%
  make_sankey() %>%

  make_long(V1, V2, V3, V4, V5, V6) %>%

  filter(!(is.na(x) & is.na(next_x) & is.na(next_node))) %>%
  mutate(keep_ft = case_when(stringr::str_detect(node, "zzzremoved") ~ "removed",
                          .default = "zkept")) %>%

             next_x = next_x,

    theme_void() +

    theme(legend.position = "none")
```

### Export Potential Conjugates

```{r}
#| output: false

write_conjugates <- function(df, ft_name, conjugate, write_path) {
  df <- df %>% 
    select(Feature, Sample, RT, `m/z`, Intensity) %>%
    spread(key = "Sample", value = "Intensity") 
  
  file_name <- paste0(write_path, "/", ft_name, "_", conjugate, ".csv")
  
  write_csv(df, file_name)
}

map2(filtered_pot_conj_glucacid_neg, 
     names(filtered_pot_conj_glucacid_neg),
     write_conjugates,
     "glcac",
     "conjugates")

map2(filtered_pot_conj_glucacid_pos, 
     names(filtered_pot_conj_glucacid_pos),
     write_conjugates,
     "glcac",
     "conjugates")


map2(filtered_pot_conj_gsh_neg, 
     names(filtered_pot_conj_gsh_neg),
     write_conjugates,
     "gsh",
     "conjugates")

map2(filtered_pot_conj_gsh_pos, 
     names(filtered_pot_conj_gsh_pos),
     write_conjugates,
     "gsh",
     "conjugates")


map2(filtered_pot_conj_sulfate_neg, 
     names(filtered_pot_conj_sulfate_neg),
     write_conjugates,
     "sulfate",
     "conjugates")

map2(filtered_pot_conj_sulfate_pos,
```
